_comment: Advisories we have looked at and chosen not to act on, per app.
Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check and a review_by date.
An expired entry fails the build on purpose: an exception nobody has
revisited is an exception nobody is accountable for.

react-router.reason: RSC Mode CSRF bypass — the vulnerable surface is React Server Components with server actions. Cortex is a client-only Vite SPA using declarative <BrowserRouter> (App.tsx): no data router, no loaders or actions, no SSR, no RSC. The advisory's only fix is a downgrade to 7.11.0, which would trade a functional regression for a risk we do not carry. Re-evaluate if Cortex ever adopts framework mode or the data router.

react-router-dom.reason: Flagged only because it depends on react-router; same reasoning and same review date.
